[[Gardock's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Gardock Stonesoul]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Reduces [[Poison]] duration on you by 20%
:Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%)
:Energy +5
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated by using inscribable staves. The [[inscription]] "Pure of Heart", which reduces [[poison]], can only be applied to [[shield]]s and [[focus item]]s.
* However, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
** A [[perfect]] [[staff]] drop with an [[Inherent modifier|inherent]] 20% Poison reduction
** [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
** [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
